QUOTE: "MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY off (shipped default) → calloc()   [direct libc]" and "the macro goes straight to libc. Free is the same with `mbedtls_free` → `free()`."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that in the default build `mbedtls_calloc`/`mbedtls_free` are macros going straight to libc `calloc`/`free`, with no dispatch function.
